item.title: Meeting your new roommate
item.context_text: You are a new student at a university in Malaysia. Today you move into your room in the student dormitory. Your roommate is from another country.
item.objective_text: Read the dorm rules, understand your roommate, and introduce yourself.
item.target_grammar: present simple for facts about you (I'm from…, I study…, I get up at…)
item.cultural_note: Roommates often talk about small rules on the first day: quiet times, cleaning and guests. A friendly question like "Is that OK with you?" helps you start well.
success_conditions: Learn three facts about your roommate
Say your name, where you are from and what you study

children.title: Read the dorm rules
children.instructions: This paper is on the door of your room. Read it. Then answer the questions.
children.prompt_text:
WELCOME TO BLOCK C
- Quiet time is from 11 pm to 7 am.
- Guests can visit from 10 am to 9 pm.
- The kitchen is on the first floor. Please clean it after you cook.
- The laundry room is open every day.

questions.explanation: "Quiet time is from 11 pm to 7 am."
"The kitchen is on the first floor."

children.title: Listen to your roommate
children.instructions: Your roommate comes in. Listen. Then answer the questions. You can listen again.
children.prompt_text: Oh, hi! You're my new roommate! I'm Lina. I'm from Indonesia, from a city called Bandung. I study computer science, it's my second year here. I get up very early, at six, because I go to the gym. Sorry! I'm very quiet in the morning, I promise. Do you want to have dinner in the kitchen later?

questions.explanation: "I'm from Indonesia, from a city called Bandung."

questions.prompt: Why does she get up early?
questions.explanation: "I get up very early, at six, because I go to the gym."

children.title: Introduce yourself
children.instructions: Answer Lina. Say your name, where you are from and what you study. Then answer her question about dinner.
children.prompt_text: Lina: So, tell me about you!
children.goal: Introduce yourself and answer the dinner question.
children.model_answer: Hi, Lina! Nice to meet you. My name is Aziz. I'm from Uzbekistan, from Tashkent. I study economics, it's my first year. Yes, dinner is a great idea!
